config.jms.destination.name: KAFKA.AGGREGATION.QUEUE
config._comment_routing: Routes messages based on combined routing key header
config._comment_application: Application must set 'routingKey' JMS property with combined value (e.g., 'RETAIL-PAYMENT')
config._comment_examples: routingKey=RETAIL-PAYMENT -> RETAIL-PAYMENT topic, routingKey=CORPORATE-PAYMENT -> CORPORATE-PAYMENT topic
config._comment_usecase: Useful when you need to segregate messages by multiple dimensions (department, region, type, etc.)
config._comment_note: Standard SMTs cannot combine multiple headers - application must pre-combine values into a single routing header
